title: Make committed Site mutations explicit when runtime activation fails
implementation: Added mutationCommitted=true and activationStatus=pending-restart to runtime activation timeout/failure Problem Details after PostgreSQL persistence has completed.
Added structured browser error parsing and a committed-but-not-active UI state so operators are not told that the Site was never saved.
Reloaded the Multi-Site list after a committed activation failure so the persisted Site and pending runtime state become visible without a duplicate retry.

verification.tddRed: The new contracts initially failed because the Problem Details extensions and structured browser outcome handling did not exist.
verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system color findings remain in app.js

boundary: Live PostgreSQL mutation followed by runtime activation failure, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, and visual responsive verification remain externally unverified.
Full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain outside this local run.
